head: 63726d4d5d8ac2490241e3f9045398ae851fc59f
purpose: Fix ICS Decoder issues #58-61: recognize iCLASS WRBL success, recover after failed writes, filter serial enumeration using USB VID/PID, and log the complete block-7 field.

must_find: The new success regex accepts unsuccessful and not successful; a write can be reported successful on failure text.

When no allowlisted USB device is present, the filter falls back to every ACM/USB port (and COM1..256 on Windows); it does not exclude the internal PM3. This fails the stated prevention goal, although the unsafe broad fallback predates the PR.
The added full-key log does not fix a demonstrated truncation in this source: raw and normalized block-7 fields were already retained. It labels invalid raw values as Key before validation.
The added tests assert helper outputs and stop-call counts, not bus recovery or effective discovery safety.
must_not: Claim the Who/ISE handshake was removed or absent.
Invent current operation-ownership APIs in this historical executor.
Treat hardware testing claims in comments as verified physical evidence.
expectations.expected_scope: Four related but independently reviewable claimed fixes; no build or branding changes in this narrow tree.
